content.short: HyperPlay is a Web3-native game launcher and aggregator that integrates wallets across different chains.
content.description: HyperPlay is a pioneering Web3-native game launcher and store aggregator designed to simplify blockchain-based gaming. By integrating with popular wallets like MetaMask, the platform allows players to carry digital assets, NFTs, and progress across multiple networks including Ethereum, Solana, and Cosmos. HyperPlay acts as a unified portal, hosting a diverse range of titles while providing a seamless bridge between traditional gaming and decentralized economies. The launcher also integrates libraries from established platforms like Epic Games Store and GOG for a hybrid experience.
content.meta: HyperPlay provides an interoperable Web3 game launcher and store aggregator. Discover HyperPlay and other Gaming Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
